features.beginnerArea: Lower-mountain beginner area at Discovery Lodge (Lightning Lift plus surface lifts), four magic carpets in learning areas, and an expanded Kidscamp Learning Area with a 220 ft carpet (Kaatskill Katerpillar)

source.note: Night skiing false: official lift hours are 9 AM-4 PM daily. Uphill travel allowed Mon-Fri during operating hours (not weekends/holidays).

character: State-run Catskills ski area with about 1,400 ft (428 m) of vertical. Gentle lower slopes around Discovery Lodge serve beginners, while the upper mountain, reached by a gondola and a high-speed quad, is mostly intermediate with some steeper pitches; it operates for day skiing only.
learning: Beginners should head to Discovery Lodge, which has the beginner area, green trails, rentals (Rossignol Experience Center) and all lesson meeting points. Four magic carpets serve the learning areas, and the Kidscamp area has a 220 ft carpet. First-Time, Second-Time and Novice lesson packages include a 2-hour lesson and a lower-mountain ticket valid on the Lightning Lift and the surface lifts beside Discovery Lodge. Group lessons are offered from age 4, with kids' ski groups for ages 4-12 and snowboard for 7-12.

season.typicalText: Among the earliest openers in New York, usually mid-to-late November with snowmaking: passholders Fri Nov 21 and public Sat Nov 22, 2025; Nov 15, 2024; passholder-only Thu Nov 16, 2023 (then closed until a planned Nov 24 reopening).
season.notes: No official 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-10-03 (opening "TBD, based on weather, conditions and snowmaking"). OnTheSnow projects Nov 20, 2026 (third-party projection, not an announcement). In 2025 ORDA announced opening dates via a Governor's press release on Nov 21. The 2025-26 closing date was not confirmed: the "Swing into Spring" promotion ran Mar 30-Apr 19, 2026 "through Closing Day" (https://www.belleayre.com/event/spring-savings/).
